performanceVerdict: read-heavy-05: Locate latency amplification in the customer export endpoint

latencyAmplifiers.statement: A separate Orders CountAsync query runs inside the customer loop, producing one query per customer after the initial load.
The controller entry point is async void, so failures cannot be awaited or returned through a Task contract.
